title: What's New: Enhanced Analysis Mode (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Live Demo: Packaging Analysis Views in AL Apps
Analysis Views in Business Central Application

features.name: Support for analysis views in AL
features.description: Developers can now package analysis views from Business Central into AL apps by exporting analysis views as JSON files and including them in page extensions or source pages.
caveats: views exported from apps are read-only and locked
users can duplicate views to create editable copies

features.name: Analysis view descriptions and tooltips
features.description: Users and developers can now add descriptions to analysis views which display as tooltips. Descriptions can be set through the rename action in analysis mode and override JSON settings.

features.name: Analysis views in page extensions
features.description: New AL syntax allows developers to define analysis views directly within page extensions using the definition file property to point to exported JSON files.
caveats: can be used with page customizations and profile extensions for role-based view availability

features.name: Analysis views in page customizations and profiles
features.description: Analysis views can be added to page customizations and assigned to specific profiles, allowing role-based availability of views for users with specific roles.
caveats: views are profile-specific when assigned through customizations

features.name: Read-only shipped analysis views
features.description: Analysis views packaged within apps are displayed as read-only with a locked icon to indicate they cannot be edited, though users can duplicate them to create editable copies.
caveats: users can duplicate views to edit copies
filter pane is removed for read-only views

features.name: Analysis view personalization
features.description: Users can hide analysis views they do not find useful through personalization mode, allowing them to customize which views appear in their interface.

features.name: Built-in analysis views across Business Central application areas
features.description: Analysis views are being added to multiple Business Central application areas including sales orders, change log entries, user lists, GL register, fixed asset ledgers, and item ledger entries.
features.status_evidence_quote: These are coming in 28.x. So, for sales we aim to have analysis views on sales orders
caveats: planned for sales, finance, inventory, and purchasing areas
